decisions.reason: Changing the physical pitch of the ESP32 breakout headers does not change any GPIO signal assignments.
The breakout-header pitch does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module model or part number.
The source changes the ESP32 through-hole breakout pitch, not the separate panel-control connector inventory or placement policy.
The breakout-header pitch does not alter the BOOT/reset controls or their capacitance values.
The 1.27 mm correction applies to the ESP32 breakout headers, not the independent JST-PH battery connector pitch.
The physical breakout-header pitch does not change the boost converter, GPIO5 enable assignment, or 5V rail behavior.
The breakout-header pitch does not affect the LED part, supply voltage, data GPIO, or level-shifting policy.
The ESP32 breakout-header pitch does not change native USB data lines or the programming-port role.
The source concerns the main-board ESP32 breakout headers, not the sensor-board interconnect or module connector pitches.
The breakout-header pitch has no entailed effect on battery protection circuitry or cutoff behavior.
The breakout-header pitch does not alter the J_BAT NTC terminal or thermal-protection behavior.
The ESP32 breakout-header pitch does not change the charge-status LED interfaces, connector, or resistor configuration.
